summary: A coarser view of a hand-entered triangle is now built from the figures you typed every time it is opened, instead of from a saved copy that never updated.
details: Opening a monthly or quarterly hand-entered triangle at a yearly view used to leave a yearly copy of it beside the file; every later yearly open served that copy, so an edit to the figures, including an Excel refresh, was never shown.
No such copy is written any more, and one left behind by an earlier version is ignored.
